html_content:
What Our Students Say

“The Conservatory is a warm and encouraging environment in which to learn.”

Amanda Walsh
Former violin and voice student

“The Quality of the music teachers continues to be top notch. The learning environment and tools are very professional.”

Donna Burgess
Parent of multiple students

“They are all very dynamic and passionate about what they do, and really allow their students to share this enthusiasm.”

Alaric Antos
Vocal and piano student (10+ years)

“The West Island Conservatory of Music has a great range of teachers which makes it easy to find a teacher that best fits.”

John McGuinness
Parent of Declan McGuinness

“The lessons helped a lot and I improved more than I could have imagined.”

Robert Groeneveld
Guitar student

“The teachers made such a connection with the kids that they still have a joy of making music.”

Damien Holtz
Parent and current student

“West island conservatory of music is one of the top music schools in Canada.”

Rebecca Fiset Côté
Singer, competition participant
